admission.justification: Spans archive model serialization/hashing, archive observation resume arguments, and worktree_status resume arguments; deleting the optional legacy field breaks SHA-256 verification of stored pre-removal archives, while failing to strip it emits invalid nextArgs rejected by the public tool schema.

applicability: Terminal enclosure cleanup archive validation, request-id hashing, argument matching, and resume nextArgs generation.
conditions: New terminal cleanup archives serialize cleanupArguments as {}.
Stored pre-removal archives carrying teardown_providers re-emit that field during cleanupRequestId verification and match post-removal cleanup retries.
exclusions: Public MCP tool schemas and CLI flags, which no longer accept teardown_providers.
TerminalWorktreeAbandonArguments, which requires exact force equality.

evidence: pytest mcp/tests/test_cleanup_repeated_archive_ready.py (passed); Reviewer route 3 pass at tree 8ae93710c4e6b5f660dd4d763f537ebaa437b42f

statement: Stored pre-removal terminal cleanup archives carrying teardown_providers continue to validate and verify their cleanupRequestId hash while newly written archives omit teardown_providers and resume nextArgs strip it so post-removal cleanup calls never pass the removed parameter.
title: Pre-removal cleanup archives verify teardown_providers; resume strips it
